newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's yields fall as liquidity fear subsides.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's yields fall as liquidity fear subsides.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds finished lower on Wednesday as investors returned to the market with liquidity fears easing, traders said.
Three-month certificate of deposit (CD) yields also declined on the back of active buying by foreign banks and securities houses, they said.
* 3-yr corporates close at 12.85 pct vs 12.98 on Tuesday
* Overnight average call rates at 13.84 pct vs 13.82
Traders said the corporate yields could drop to the 12.80 percent level on Thursday.
Three-month CD yields also fell in line with yields on commercial papers (CP). Foreign banks and securities houses were active buyers, they said.
